serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Bluescape is the secure workspace for government and defense operations, giving teams a common picture to act with speed and precision. FedRAMP-authorized and trusted across national security, it brings intelligence, plans, and imagery together in one place, so mission partners align quickly and make time-critical decisions with confidence. 

Bluescape supports use cases such as operations centers, complex planning, intel and information analysis, and cyber/critical infrastructure monitoring.

With integrations to COTS and GOTS software packages, and a full API for custom content workflows, Bluescape supports mission partner and interagency collaboration requirements.

Use the power of AI to summarize and make inquiries of document data within workspaces
Plug in third-party AI and ML tools for data aggregation/analysis.
n8n for Government by Bluescape
Aggregate and train data from multiple LLMs to produce appropriate mission analysis and other AI outputs in a secure environment.
Create pattern-of-life profiles for tracking targets and collect metadata to storyboard incident and event chronologies.
Visualize and analyze geo-data
Stand up drone command centers with multiple live video and data feeds, sharable to unlimited mission partners.
Build your own integrations to connect to systems of record and port content upward through cross-domain solutions.
 

Bluescape has hardened its Government solution to DoD SRG IL4 control baselines and FedRAMP Moderate so that any Federal Civilian or Defense customer can create and handle rich media and operational content through any cross-domain solution -- from FedRAMP to NIPR to SIPR to JWICS.

Bluescape features include:

Document viewing and editing
High-resolution image upload
Video upload + synchronized playback
Presentation mode with Canvas Carousels
Multi-page document export / Intelligence pkg production + exporter (PDF and PPTX)
Persistent Infinite Whiteboard / Workspace
Lead/follow capability
Task cards
Support for embedded web applications
User Access Management and Admin Console
